description: 阅读理解：基于课文的选择题，检验理解程度

questions.question: Who was Yuan Longping?
questions.explanation: 课文第一句说：Yuan Longping was a great scientist. 袁隆平是一位伟大的科学家。

questions.question: When was Yuan Longping born?
questions.questionCn: 袁隆平什么时候出生的？
questions.explanation: 课文说：He was born in 1930 in Beijing. 他1930年出生于北京。

questions.question: Where was Yuan Longping born?
questions.explanation: 课文说：He was born in 1930 in Beijing. 他1930年出生于北京。

questions.question: What do people call Yuan Longping?
questions.explanation: 课文说：People call him "the father of hybrid rice". 人们称他为"杂交水稻之父"。

questions.question: When did Yuan Longping begin to work on hybrid rice?
questions.questionCn: 袁隆平什么时候开始研究杂交水稻的？
questions.explanation: 课文说：In 1964, he began to work on hybrid rice. 1964年，他开始研究杂交水稻。

questions.question: When did he develop hybrid rice?
questions.questionCn: 他什么时候研发出杂交水稻的？
questions.explanation: 课文说：In 1973, he developed hybrid rice. 1973年，他研发出杂交水稻。

questions.question: What does "never gave up" mean?
questions.explanation: give up 是「放弃」的意思，never gave up 就是「从不放弃」，也就是继续努力的意思。

questions.question: What does hybrid rice do?

options.label: B
options.text: It feeds people all over the world.
options.textCn: 它养活了全世界的人们。

questions.explanation: 课文最后一句说：It feeds people all over the world. 它养活了全世界的人们。

questions.question: Why was Yuan Longping great?

options.label: C
options.text: Because he helped people all over the world.
options.textCn: 因为他帮助了全世界的人。

options.label: D
options.text: Because he lived a long life.

questions.explanation: 袁隆平研发的杂交水稻养活了全世界的人，他用科学帮助了他人，这就是他的伟大之处。

questions.question: What did Mrs Fox ask the class to write about?
questions.questionCn: Fox老师让全班写关于什么的作文？
questions.explanation: 课文说：Mrs Fox asked the class to write about their heroes. Fox老师让全班同学写关于他们的英雄。

questions.question: Who did Bobby want to write about at first?

options.label: C
options.textCn: 一位著名的科学家或发明家。

questions.explanation: Bobby说：A famous scientist or inventor. They work hard and do great things. 一位著名的科学家或发明家。他们努力工作，做伟大的事情。

questions.question: What did Mum do for Mrs Pig?

options.label: B
options.text: She did the shopping for her.

options.label: D
options.text: She took her baby to the park.

questions.explanation: 妈妈说：I want to do the shopping for Mrs Pig. 我想给Pig太太买东西。Bobby也说：You do the shopping for Mrs Pig every week.

questions.question: What did Mum do for Mrs Mouse?

options.label: A
options.text: She took her baby to the park.

options.label: B
options.text: She did the shopping for her.

questions.explanation: Mrs Mouse说：Thanks for taking my baby to the park yesterday. 谢谢你昨天带我宝宝去公园。

questions.question: Who is Bobby's hero at the end?
questions.explanation: Bobby说：You're my hero, Mum! 你是我的英雄，妈妈！

questions.question: What can we learn from the story?
questions.questionCn: 我们能从这个故事中学到什么？

options.label: A
options.textCn: 只有出名的人才是英雄。

options.label: B
options.text: Great people can be the people around us.
options.textCn: 伟大的人可以是我们身边的人。

questions.explanation: 课文最后一句说：Great people don't have to be famous. They can be the people around you. 伟大的人不一定非得出名。他们可以是你身边的人。
